create_VllmInductorPass: create a VllmInductorPass subclass with timing, logging, and graph dumping utilities for inductor compilation
register_VllmFusionPatternMatcherPass: register VllmPatternReplacement pattern/replacement pairs in a VllmFusionPatternMatcherPass for FX graph fusion
run_VllmFusionPatternMatcherPass: run a VllmFusionPatternMatcherPass on a torch fx.Graph to apply registered pattern replacements

get_match_table: get a snapshot of the global match table mapping pass names to their total pattern match counts
